Lagos:
The Lagos State Chapter also known as the Flagship Chapter of the Nigerian Institute of Quantity Surveyors brings together quantity surveyors practising across Lagos State, in the South West geopolitical zone. Established in 1975, the chapter serves a membership working mostly in public and private infrastructure, education and housing projects across the state.

Working with the National Secretariat, the chapter runs regular continuing professional development sessions, distinguished lecture series, courtesy visits and an annual engineering workshop. It engages the state's ministries and agencies on procurement and cost management, and supports students through its links with universities in the state and the Young Quantity Surveyors Forum.

Quantity surveyors in Lagos State can take part in chapter activities by contacting the chapter secretariat.
